result.title: COHERE4D: Training-Free Dense Surface Alignment for Coherent Metric 4D Human-Scene Reconstruction
result.summary: Human and scene foundation models offer complementary strengths for monocular 4D reconstruction: human models recover metric-scale body meshes but lack scene grounding, whereas scene models estimate globally consistent 3D geometry and camera motion without reliable metric scale. Crucially, both models reconstruct the same foreground human surface. Yet existing methods do not directly exploit this shared surface: lacking reliable foreground human geometry in scene reconstructions, earlier approaches either resort to sparse contact constraints or learn data-driven alignment modules that generalize poorly to out-of-distribution scenes. We present COHERE4D, a training-free framework that directly registers the human surfaces predicted by independently pretrained human and scene foundation models to reconstruct a coherent, metric 4D world. COHERE4D establishes dense, pixel-aligned 3D correspondences over the visible human surface and employs RANSAC with cross-frame consensus to suppress outliers from occlusion, background contamination, and depth noise. This formulation solves for two complementary geometric quantities: a sequence-level shared scale that calibrates scene geometry and camera motion to metric human size, and per-frame human translations that align camera-space human meshes with the scaled scene geometry to enforce spatial and temporal consistency. Across diverse backbones and benchmarks, COHERE4D substantially outperforms prior methods in human--scene alignment, metric scene and camera pose reconstruction, and global human motion estimation, adding only 4,ms/frame, enabling overall inference at up to 14 FPS.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练框架 COHERE4D，将独立预训练的人体模型与场景基础模型所预测的同一人体表面直接配准，用像素级稠密 3D 对应加跨帧 RANSAC 共识抑制遮挡与深度噪声离群点，求解序列级共享尺度与逐帧人体平移，得到度量一致的 4D 人体—场景重建。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「稠密对应 + 跨帧共识剔除离群」的鲁棒对齐机制，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与 latent 对齐可信度校验提供可核查的方法线索；论文本身聚焦几何重建，与 VLM 推理状态生成无直接联系。
